items.title: MSIG Hong Kong hires Kathy Mak as senior manager for financial lines
items.summary: She joins from Chubb, where she was a senior underwriter for financial lines since May 2022.

items.title: Hong Kong’s Wang Fuk Court fire claims top US$74m a year on
items.summary: Total of 168 people died following the fire in November last year, with China Taiping the underwriter responsible for all the relevant insurance policies.
